versions.changelog: Fix env requirement: GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY now optional (matches optionalBins). Clarify SMS/email access are opt-in triggers, not always-on.

Add comprehensive metadata: declare required bins (playwright-cli), env vars, install instructions, and full sensitive access declarations (PII, SMS, email, messaging scope). Resolves ClawHub security scanner findings.

v1.2.0: Security review fixes. Separated external binaries (playwright-cli, goplaces) from OpenClaw built-in tools (web_search, web_fetch, message, calendar, imsg) — built-ins need no installation. Tightened SMS searches to specific sender chat IDs only (no broad inbox scans). Gmail search narrowed to from:opentable/resy senders only on explicit modify/cancel. Clarified partner notifications are always draft-first with user approval. Fixed stale user_last_name → last_name config reference.

v1.1.0: Full transparency pass — declared all external tool dependencies (SMS, Gmail, goplaces, web_search, web_fetch) with sensitivity levels. Added missing config fields (first_name, last_name, user_email, user_phone) to schema. Documented auth state persistence and data storage. Added purge instructions. Onboarding now collects email/phone during setup.
Initial release — restaurant reservations (OpenTable/Resy), movie tickets, event tickets with price comparison, weather, budgets, calendar, partner notifications, and full evening orchestration.
